para1: The final girl never asked for a rematch, but the franchise needs one more name on the poster. Sound familiar to anyone who's watched a boxer get talked out of retirement for a payday nobody wanted them to take?
para2: This week's session log covers a sad Spider-Man, an ocean-sized endurance slog, a guilt-horror film that keeps nagging at me on the bag, and the Bourdain biopic that left me hungrier than my last three meals combined. But the main event is a deep-dive on the new slasher-about-slashers, the one where a director gets obsessed with dragging the original final girl back into the ring. I get into what that says about comeback fights nobody schedules because you're healed, only because somebody needs you to prove you can still take it. The real opponent was never the guy across the ring anyway.
